v3-beta-welcome.title: Welcome to the v3 beta
v3-beta-welcome.p1: We've made a backup of your database automatically, but making your own before you rely on the beta is never a bad idea. Data loss is not expected, but this is a beta, so it can happen.
v3-beta-welcome.p2: Please understand that this is a work in progress. There will be many style and functionality changes that happen very rapidly. When we change something, we've done it thoughtfully.
v3-beta-welcome.p3: We welcome suggestions, but we're already trying to contain our own scope-creep impulses. New features are unlikely to be added until after v3 is official.
v3-beta-welcome.p4: That said, we are very eager for bug reports, input on ergonomics, and feedback about what is confusing.
v3-beta-welcome.p5: We're very happy to entertain merge requests, but please first raise them as a feature request on Discord or GitLab so we can discuss it. Things are changing very rapidly behind the scenes and we want to avoid duplicated effort.

ctc-aligner.title: Try the new CTC aligner
ctc-aligner.p1: Storyteller can now align a book by matching its text straight to the audio, without transcribing the narration first.
ctc-aligner.p2: It is more accurate and gives better word timings. You can switch now, or change it later under Settings, Processing.

alignment.title: Alignment

whisper.label: Transcription-based alignment
whisper.description: Transcribes the narration directly to text, then matches that transcript to the book text using <error_link>Error Align</error_link>. Well tested, and has many options for offloading transcription to a third-party service.

ctc.label: CTC forced alignment (experimental)
ctc.description: Aligns text to audio using the Connectionist Temporal Classification (CTC) algorithm. It is more accurate, potentially much faster, gives better word timings and works well across languages.

alignment.autoExclude: Skip front and back matter automatically
alignment.autoExcludeDescription: Covers, contents, copyright pages and indexes are left out.
alignment.whisperCppDescription: Runs on the server hosting Storyteller. Nothing leaves this machine, and speed depends on its hardware.
alignment.googleCloudDescription: Google Cloud Speech-to-Text. Paid cloud API. Requires an API key.
alignment.microsoftAzureDescription: Azure AI speech recognition. Paid cloud API. Requires a subscription key and service region.
alignment.amazonTranscribeDescription: AWS transcription via an S3 bucket. Paid cloud API. Requires AWS credentials.
alignment.openaiCloudDescription: OpenAI's hosted transcription API. Also works with any OpenAI-compatible endpoint via a custom base URL.
alignment.deepgramDescription: Deepgram's hosted speech-to-text API. Paid cloud API. Requires an API key.
alignment.whisperThreadsWarning: Above 1 is faster but can make alignment less accurate.
alignment.whisperServerDescription: Offload transcription to a Ghost Story server running on another, faster machine. Any whisper.cpp-compatible server works too.

ctc-local.label: On this server
ctc-local.description: Runs on the machine hosting Storyteller.

ctc-server.label: On another server

alignment.ctcBatchSizeDescription: Higher is faster on a GPU and uses more memory.
alignment.autoExcludeTip: Chapters that are only sometimes narrated, like forewords and dedications, are still aligned and flagged in the report. You can include or exclude any chapter from the report.
alignment.modelTurboHint: Best balance of accuracy and speed. Can be slow without a GPU.

legend.track: Thin strip: the audio track, coloured by how much of it was placed

explain.chapters: Each chapter block is coloured by the share of its sentences that were matched to the narration. Approved chapters count as fully matched, included chapters are shown as good, excluded chapters are dimmed.
explain.fills: A solid fill is sentences matched to the narration. A lighter fill is sentences whose timing was filled in from their neighbours. Stripes mark sentences that were not read. A dashed outline marks audio with no text. Dimmed blocks are skipped chapters.
explain.track: The thin strip above each block is the audio track. It is coloured by how much of the track was placed in the book.
